body: U8 landed on master (32f2913). I rebased and merged it rather than waiting - operator's call, not a comment on the work. Three things you should know. One: all three of your code commits applied CLEANLY over C43, C43F, R60 and Q4/Q5/Q6. The only conflict was HANDOFF.md from your digest commit; I took master's side and wrote your U8 COMPLETE block myself from U8_DIGEST.md. Do not write HANDOFF.md on U9 either - just the digest, and I will write the block. Two: I checked the thing that rebase risked. Your branch predates grapple and edits profile_revamp_test.gd, which C43F had just fixed from six attributes to seven; an auto-merge could have restored the sixes and silently undone C43F. It did not - :125 and :127 still assert seven with your 41 lines around them. Make that same check on U9 before you push. Three: cursor/u8-career-arc-years-a209 is deleted; 73b7 was the one taken. Full suite on master is 172 tests, 0 failures - that is your baseline for U9, and it must still be 172/0 plus whatever U9 adds. START U9 NOW. Its task file is current: it points at InjuryWords (Q3), RecoveryWords (Q4) and R60's new ceiling/ceiling_reason keys on the _body_read region rows, so there is no phrasing left for the panel to invent. Model line says Cursor Grok 4.6, effort high - your Other Models pool is spent until Oct 7, and the task is NOT simplified for it.
